seoTitle: Clément DOUIN | Independent software engineer, Rust
seoDesc: Independent software engineer since 2016: architecture, backend, tooling and web, with a strong affinity for Rust and for email, contacts and calendars through Pimalaya.
title: Software engineering, built to last.
lead: I join your team or take a project **end to end on the server side**: architecture, backends, APIs, tooling. Fourteen years of engineering, ten of them independent, with **Rust** as my language of choice and a strong affinity for *email, contacts and calendars*, through the open-source project I lead, [Pimalaya](https://pimalaya.org).

services.title: Software engineering
services.text: Backends, APIs, services and command-line tools, *from the first design to production*. **Rust by choice**, and I fit the stack your team already runs.

services.title: Rust
services.text: New Rust projects, **audits** and **rescue** of existing code: clear boundaries, I/O-free cores, tests against *real* systems.

services.title: PIM integration

abbr.title: Personal information management: email, contacts and calendars

services.text: Your product talking to **Gmail**, **Microsoft 365** or standard servers: sign-in, discovery, sync, with the provider quirks *already known*.

services.title: Maintenance
services.text: What I build *keeps working*: dependency and platform updates, protocol changes, **a version line you can rely on**.

workLead: Since 2022 I lead Pimalaya, an open-source project funded by the [NLnet foundation](https://nlnet.nl) and the European Commission. It builds **Rust tools for email, contacts and calendars**, written *from the standards up* and tested against the providers people use. It is where my Rust and PIM experience comes from.

work.name: Pimalaya libraries
work.text: IMAP, SMTP, JMAP, CalDAV, CardDAV, OAuth and discovery, as libraries *any runtime* can drive.

work.name: Himalaya
work.text: An email client for the terminal, *used worldwide* and scriptable through its JSON output.

work.name: Pimalaya for Android
work.text: Mail, contacts and calendars in **one offline-first app**, on the same libraries.

work.name: With Red Arrow
work.text: A desktop client for mail, contacts and calendars built on the Pimalaya stack, as its **first partner**.

archiveBefore: Before Pimalaya, *ten years of missions* for companies such as Piana, Swan, Tokeny and Colas:
consultingText: A feature to ship, a system to design, code to audit, a team to unblock. *Remote, from France*, in English or French.
partnershipText: Your product or your servers on the Pimalaya stack, **tested on every release** and maintained *year after year*.
contactLead: A **short call** first, then a written proposal with a *fixed scope*.
